sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Kotoklan Fluffy Epic Idle are centered around growing your cat collection and earning gold. The game starts with a single cat, and as you progress, you can purchase more cats using the gold you've earned. Each cat is a source of additional profit, and the more cats you have, the more gold you'll earn.

As you progress through the game, you'll unlock various upgrades and items that can help you grow your cat collection faster. These upgrades include things like the ability to speed up your cat's earnings, increase the number of cats you can have, and even attract more cats to your empire.

One of the key mechanics in Kotoklan Fluffy Epic Idle is the concept of 'clicking' on your cats to earn gold. The more you click, the more gold you'll earn. However, this mechanic can be a bit tedious, especially for casual players. To alleviate this, the game offers various upgrades that can speed up your cat's earnings, making the clicking process less monotonous.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Kotoklan Fluffy Epic Idle are simple yet engaging, making it a great choice for players of all skill levels.
